addPlant.lead: Snap a photo. AI reads the plant and fills in the catalog for you; you stay in control of every field.
addPlant.photoLead: Add a clear photo first. Then analyze it with AI, or leave that off and fill the form yourself.
addPlant.photoLeadOne: Add a clear photo first. Then analyze it with AI, or leave that off and fill the form yourself.

addPlant.bannerManual: Not verified by AI. You're choosing the class yourself.

admin.title: Admin
admin.operatorOnly: Admin opens only with your Google account.
admin.issuesLead: What people sent when something failed. Their note is here. The request, stack, and browser details are in the row.
admin.configurationsLead: One catalog for admin, market filters, and new plants. Add categories and subcategories with their own properties.
admin.systemLead: Control which pages are shown and which features are available.
admin.serverLead: Backoffice tables for live data — preview rows, bulk actions, reports, members, and transactions.
admin.requestsLead: Pending applications and plants the catalog does not know yet. History keeps what was added and what was declined.
admin.apisLead: Photo identify — plant check, species, and catalog fields.
admin.apisChainLead: Add Plant runs three stages. Each one can be Ready (real API) or Mock (no credits). A plant check that says it is not a plant stops before Pl@ntNet.
admin.apisModeMockHint: Canned provider responses. No credits spent.
admin.apisPlaygroundLead: A pipeline run sets Ready or Mock on each stage. A single stage uses the mode below.
admin.apisResultEmpty: Run a test to see the result.
admin.apisStageGateLead: Gemini looks at the photo and only decides if it is a plant.
admin.apisStageSpeciesLead: Pl@ntNet names the species. It runs only after the plant check says yes.
admin.apisStageDraftLead: Gemini fills PlantX fields from the species result and the catalog as it is now.
admin.apisHistoryLead: Every identify request, from Add Plant and from this playground.
admin.serverUpBody: Reading users, plants, and activities from the database API.
admin.serverDownBody: Writes stay blocked until the API answers.
admin.serverSliceUnavailable: This list could not be loaded.
admin.serverFailTimeout: The API did not answer in time.
admin.serverFailHtml: HTTP {status} — the host returned a page instead of the API.
admin.serverFailHttp: HTTP {status}{error} — the API refused the request.
admin.serverFailDown: HTTP {status} — nothing is answering the API. The server process is down, or the host could not reach it.
admin.systemAppLead: Off sends visitors to the not-launched page. You still see the app while signed in.
admin.systemPagesLead: Stop showing a page to put it under maintenance. Direct visits see a maintenance notice.
admin.systemFeaturesLead: Each group is a feature. Hideable components sit open under their page. Always shown and non controllable pieces stay folded.
admin.catalogLead: Categories, subcategories, and properties are the same source the market and add-plant form use.
admin.suggestedCategoriesLead: Plants members suggested or scans found that the catalog doesn't have yet. Review one to add it, or create an entry yourself.
admin.suggestedFormLead: Filled from the identify answer and the scan photo. Edit, then save the category, subcategory, and properties together.
admin.suggestedPropertyInvalid: Each property needs a name and at least one option with a sign. Market signs must be unique.
admin.suggestedSaveFailed: Could not save. The ticker or a property sign is already used.

admin.subcategoryChipHint: Choose a working category, then select a subcategory to add and edit its properties.

admin.optionsHint: Each option replaces the property placeholder. Signs show in parentheses.
admin.requiredPropertiesHint: Add or edit labels and options. These apply to every plant in the catalog.
admin.noCategoryProperties: No properties on this category yet.
admin.noSubProperties: No properties on this subcategory yet.
admin.editCatalogHint: Choose what you are editing. Subcategories and properties apply to this selection.
admin.noSubcategories: No subcategories in this category yet.
admin.marketNamesLead: Every name from a category, its subcategories, and the properties that apply.
admin.apisReadyNeedsKey: {provider} has no API key. Ready makes every Add Plant fail for growers. Set the key, or use Mock.
admin.apisSpeciesNotInCatalogNote: This name is only a hint for Catalog fields. Whether the plant is in the catalog is decided by Catalog fields.
admin.newCatalogEntryLead: Create a category with its first variety and properties. It joins the catalog right away.
admin.suggestedFormLeadMember: A member suggested this. Fill in the catalog details, then add it.
admin.appActivatedNote: {name} is activated and can sign in.
admin.scanReadOnly: From a scan. Info only, nobody asked to add it.

guest.tasksTitle: Log in to see your tasks

guest.homeTitle: Log in to see what's growing

guest.passportTitle: Log in to open this passport
guest.passportBody: A plant's passport belongs to its grower and is shared with members.
guest.introTitle: Every plant gets its own story

guest.introStep1Body: One clear photo of the plant is enough to start.
guest.introStep2Body: It matches the photo to the catalog. You check it and change anything.
guest.introStep3Body: Watering and photo reminders, and a passport that keeps every step.
guest.introNote: Try it now: your first plants are saved on this device. Log in to keep them in your greenhouse.
guest.introStageLabel: Example: a plant photo that becomes a plant passport with care reminders
guest.savedNote: Saved on this device only. Log in and they move into your greenhouse.

landing.kicker: For people who grow at home
landing.heroSub: Your plants, care tasks and progress photos in one greenhouse. See what needs attention today — and how far each plant has come.
landing.tourTitle: Take a walk through the app.
landing.tourLead: These are real PlantX screens. Pick an area, and switch between desktop and phone where both exist.
landing.tourHomeTitle: See what other growers are up to.
landing.tourHomeBody: A feed of greenhouses from growers near you: new plants, fresh cuttings, watering days and progress photos.
landing.tourGreenhouseTitle: Your greenhouse levels up with you.
landing.tourGreenhouseBody: The level ring and the XP to the next level sit at the top. Below it is every plant you grow.
landing.tourGreenhouse1: 50 XP for each plant you add
landing.tourGreenhouse2: 10 XP for each care task you finish
landing.tourGreenhouse3: Add a plant from a single photo
landing.tourPassportBody: Photos, species, health, size and stage, with the full care history behind it.
landing.tourPassport1: An AI verified badge when you keep the answer
landing.tourPassport2: Planned care and history per plant
landing.tourPassport3: Up to three photos, each checked
landing.tourTasksTitle: Care that shows up on time.
landing.tourTasksBody: A calendar of watering and photo check-ins for each plant. Tick one off, it lands on the passport, and the greenhouse earns 10 XP.
landing.tourTasks1: Filter by plant or by care type
landing.tourTasks3: Task count right in the nav
landing.tourCatalogTitle: A care guide for every species.
landing.tourCatalogBody: Light and water for this season, for every species and variety in PlantX.
landing.tourCatalog2: The same species AI matches to
landing.aiTitle: From one photo to a full plant passport.
landing.aiLead: Add a plant with a single photo. AI checks it is a plant, tells you the species and fills in its passport. You can confirm or change anything.
landing.ai1Body: One clear photo is all Add Plant needs to start.
landing.ai2Body: It checks the photo is really a plant, then compares leaf shape, veins and color with known species.
landing.ai3Body: Species, variety, size and stage are picked for you. Tap any of them to change it.
landing.ai4Body: Keep the answer and the plant carries an AI verified badge on its passport.
landing.joinBody: Sign up with your Google account, add your first plant from a photo, and let PlantX keep track of its care. Already growing here? Log in with the same button.
landing.soonLead: We're building these with the community. They are not open yet.
landing.soonMarketBody: Swap and sell plants and cuttings with other growers. Every plant brings its passport along, so you know its whole story before it comes home.
landing.soonRankBody: Swipe through other growers' plants and cheer on the ones that are thriving.
landing.benefit1Body: A clear overview of your collection, from your first cutting to your fullest shelf.
landing.benefit2Body: Keep watering checks and progress photos on your task list.
landing.benefit3Body: Build a care history you can look back on, one update at a time.
